item.description:
Draftava 1.3.23
- Create projects in user-selected locations, including local folders, iCloud Drive, and external storage. - Open and switch between V2 projects using the File menu or project switcher. - Remember recently opened projects and restore access after restarting Draftava. - Restore the approved welcome screen for creating or opening projects. - Return to the previous project when creation or opening is canceled. - Preserve existing V2 project data and V1 migration safeguards.
